name: APG-68-class radar in DCS, run by a skilled human
description: The player's F-16 radar in DCS run by a skilled human: since SIM_REV 24 the same numbers as APG-68-DCS (65 km, 4 s), which the stick pilot now reaches with a narrowed scan and the antenna aimed.

sources.MAX_RANGE: DCS, 23 October: first bugged track 52.8-75.3 km (mean 65.6) in 7 stick fights, the target in the scan and the antenna's coverage from further out; 65 km +-15% spans 55-75
sources.REF_RCS_M2: set equal to the F-16's RCS, so F-16 targets are detected at MAX_RANGE
sources.ACQUIRE_S: as APG-68-DCS since SIM_REV 24 (the stick pilot now runs the radar as a skilled human does)
